subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: Should workspace scans adopt a fixed 4 MiB ignore-file ceiling with terminal fail-closed exclusion of the affected subtree?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but the threshold and fallback intentionally change discovery for existing large workspaces and require product ownership rather than an automated code repair.

options.title: Accept the fail-closed policy
options.body: Merge the current implementation and treat ignore files above 4 MiB as invalid policy that terminally excludes the containing subtree.

options.title: Revise the threshold or fallback
options.body: Choose a different ceiling, diagnostic, or oversized-file behavior and update the tests and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the hard limit
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until maintainers define a broader workspace-scan resource and error-reporting policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the fail-closed policy
recommendation.body: Merge the current implementation and treat ignore files above 4 MiB as invalid policy that terminally excludes the containing subtree.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a shared core compatibility choice whose remaining blocker is policy acceptance, not implementation repair.
